:::{#def-prediction-bias}
#### Bias of a prediction

Let $\hat f(x_0)$ be a prediction (a random variable,
because it depends on the random training data)
of the value $f(x_0)$ of a fixed function $f$ at a point $x_0$.
The **bias** of $\hat f(x_0)$ is

$$\bias{\hat f(x_0)} \eqdef \E{\hat f(x_0)} - f(x_0)$$

:::

::: notes
If $f(x_0) = 10$ and the predictions,
over repeated training sets,
average $11$, then $\bias{\hat f(x_0)} = 11 - 10 = 1$,
the squared bias in @exr-prediction-error.
:::
